edits.anchor: # [R37 可达性收敛（W37）] 剪枝收敛后，仅保留从 entry 出发、沿正常
edits.repl:
# [R64-D3-J2 merge-bounded jump-edge join prune]  W14-C above runs only for
        # unbounded collection (`not merge`); a merge-bounded BFS therefore keeps any
        # block it happens to pass through on the way to the merge.  trade_info_utils.
        # trade_operation: the else arm of `if operation == 'delete'` (entry 874,
        # merge = loop header 654) swallows block 1000 = `write_info.append(items)`,
        # which is the post-if statement of the ENCLOSING `if items[0] in
        # trade_id_list` and is entered from outside by that condition block's
        # POP_JUMP_FORWARD_IF_FALSE (656 -> 1000).  Criterion: a collected block is a
        # join (not branch-internal continuation) iff some predecessor outside
        # collected+stop reaches it by an explicit JUMP edge rather than by the
        # fall-through successor.  Fall-through preds stay untouched, which is why
        # the with-cleanup tail 1326 -> 1332 inside IfRegion@1082 keeps its block.
        # The R14b child-structural exemption is deliberately NOT reused here: its
        # region-overlap test is satisfied by every ANCESTOR LoopRegion and would
        # exempt 656 unconditionally (measured: logs/probe_cbb_726.txt).
        if len(collected) > 1 and merge is not None:
            _j2_in_set = set(collected)
            _j2_pruned = True
            while _j2_pruned:
                _j2_pruned = False
                for _j2_b in list(collected):
                    if _j2_b is entry:
                        continue
                    if not any(_j2_p in _j2_in_set for _j2_p in _j2_b.predecessors):
                        continue
                    _j2_li = _j2_b.get_last_instruction()
                    _j2_none_tail = False
                    if _j2_li is not None and _j2_li.opname == 'RETURN_CONST':
                        _j2_none_tail = _j2_li.argval is None
                    elif _j2_li is not None and _j2_li.opname == 'RETURN_VALUE':
                        _j2_prev = [i for i in _j2_b.instructions
                                    if i.offset < _j2_li.offset
                                    and i.opname not in ('NOP', 'CACHE', 'EXTENDED_ARG', 'RESUME')]
                        _j2_none_tail = bool(_j2_prev) and \
                            _j2_prev[-1].opname == 'LOAD_CONST' and \
                            _j2_prev[-1].argval is None
                    if _j2_none_tail:
                        continue
                    for _j2_p in _j2_b.predecessors:
                        if _j2_b in (_j2_p.exception_successors or set()):
                            continue
                        if _j2_p in _j2_in_set or _j2_p in stop:
                            continue
                        _j2_ft = [s for s in _j2_p.successors
                                   if s.start_offset > _j2_p.end_offset
                                   and s not in (_j2_p.exception_successors or set())]
                        if not _j2_ft:
                            continue
                        if min(_j2_ft, key=lambda s: s.start_offset) is _j2_b:
                            continue
                        collected.remove(_j2_b)
                        _j2_in_set.discard(_j2_b)
                        _j2_pruned = True
                        break

        # [R37 可达性收敛（W37）] 剪枝收敛后，仅保留从 entry 出发、沿正常
